uncited: **Retrieve Projection Ray Plane (PRP):** Identify the set of projection rays belonging to the same scan line of the projected 2D frame buffer.
**Fetch Beams:** Retrieve the PRP from the CFB as $n$ beams parallel to a primary axis.
**De-skew (Shear):** Shift each beam left or right within the 2DSB to align all viewing rays vertically (parallel to a 2D axis).
**Transfer to RPT:** Transfer rays to the RPT.
Each VCU combines two voxels in 7 time units.
For algorithms requiring a 27-voxel neighborhood (central voxel + 26 neighbors), use multiple parallel 2DSBs.
